steps.title: Wait for approval and security review
steps.detail: Partnerships reviews first; if approved, the GRC team starts the Security Review. No timeline is published.

steps.title: Complete Partner Checklist and QA
steps.detail: Complete the checklist and share it with Gusto for QA review. Production keys follow approval.

traps.title: No production test accounts

traps.title: Scopes are assigned by Gusto

claims.label: provider_docs
claims.quote:
To refresh a token, send a POST request to the [/oauth/token](https://docs.gusto.com/embedded-payroll/reference/oauth-access-token)  endpoint with:

* `client_id` and `client_secret` from your [application](https://dev.gusto.com/applications)
* `refresh_token`
* `grant_type` set to `refresh_token`

```curl
curl --location --request POST 'https://api.gusto-demo.com/oauth/token' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
  "client_id": "{{client_id}}",
  "client_secret": "{{client_secret}}",
  "refresh_token": "T0jHy4Oc3FWi7hDPEMPdpbGiLpB0rWeb1ZJOJVB36oU",
  "grant_type": "refresh_token"
}'
```

You’ll receive a new access and refresh token:

```json
{
  "access_token": "737HdeXfIqgx-NfaUFRuhV7JDe6ns6ptanJSMuQzjlc",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 7200,
  "refresh_token": "iEjL96L9Pndwmi-xVX3Q-xbrvvhnjHYGX87sopgGJ8E"
}
```

When you use the new access token in a Gusto API call, your previous refresh token will be revoked.
